newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Citra Marga notes BBB-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Citra Marga notes BBB-minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had assigned a BBB-minus rating to the proposed US$100 million 144A notes issue by Citra Marga Finance BV, which is guaranteed by PT Citra Marga Nusphala Persada.
S&P said in a statement the rating reflected the high demand for travel on the Jakarta Intra Urban Tollway and CMNP's strong cash flow position.

But it was offset by uncertainty over potential projects involving CMNP, the refinancing risk of a lumpy maturity profile and some uncertainty on toll road policies in Indonesia, the rating agency said.
The rating outlook is stable and any uncertainty regarding key shareholders is not anticipated to unduly impact CMNP's key operations and strong financial profile, it said.
